title: Design a Leaderboard

solutions.name: HashMap + TreeMap
solutions.timeComplexity: O(K log n) for top, O(log n) for others
solutions.description: HashMap maps playerId to score. TreeMap (descending) maps score to count. top() iterates TreeMap collecting top K scores. addScore/reset update both maps.

solutions.name: HashMap with Sorting on top()
solutions.timeComplexity: O(n log n) for top, O(1) for add/reset
solutions.description: Use a HashMap mapping playerId to score. For top(K), collect all scores into a list, sort descending, and sum the top K values.
